# Tilt-shift

The miniature-model look of a tilted lens: a sharp band of focus, with blur growing smoothly on either side.

<EffectDemo effect="tilt-shift" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { tiltShift } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/tilt-shift';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(tiltShift({ preset: 'miniature' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.focus = 0.45`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Type    | Default | Range     | Description                                           |
| ------------------------ | ------- | ------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `focus`                  | number  | `0.45`  | 0 – 1     | Position of the sharp band across the frame.          |
| `width`                  | number  | `0.18`  | 0 – 1     | Width of the sharp band.                              |
| `feather`                | number  | `0.3`   | 0.01 – 1  | Distance over which the blur ramps up.                |
| `angle`                  | number  | `0`     | 0 – 180 ° | Rotation of the band; 0 is horizontal.                |
| `blur`                   | number  | `10`    | 0 – 40 px | Blur radius at full strength.                         |
| `samples` _(structural)_ | integer | `24`    | 8 – 64    | Texture reads per pixel; more is smoother and slower. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                   |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `miniature` | `blur: 14`, `width: 0.12`, `feather: 0.25` |
| `subtle`    | `blur: 5`, `width: 0.3`                    |
| `diagonal`  | `angle: 30`, `blur: 12`                    |
| `vertical`  | `angle: 90`, `focus: 0.5`, `blur: 12`      |

Apply one with `tiltShift({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.0 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/tilt-shift`, including the shared effect runtime.
